verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs never describe a GitHub repository integration that gives agents code access or lets them open pull requests. The only related items are generic MCP server and custom-tool connections, which are developer building blocks rather than a repo integration. One community user hit a GitHub OAuth redirect error, which hints that a connect flow may exist but documents no working capability and nothing about PRs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it
